name: Tkashi Ruins
summary: The Tkashi Ruins are ancient stone remnants situated southwest of Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Overrun by hostile Bloodscalp trolls, the site remains a stronghold of the tribe.

sections.title: Stones of the Bloodscalp
sections.body: Perched southwest of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting camp, the crumbling stone masonry of the Tkashi Ruins marks the ancient domain of Stranglethorn's jungle trolls. Today, the encampment is heavily occupied by the Bloodscalp tribe, who aggressively defend the territory and practice their shamanistic rituals among the vines and decayed stone. While Hemet Nesingwary noted passing through the ruins without trouble in his hunting memoirs, modern travelers find the trolls far less accommodating, guarding valuable tribal relics buried among the rubble.

faq.q: Who lives in the Tkashi Ruins?
faq.answer: The ruins are occupied by the Bloodscalp tribe, a hostile faction of jungle trolls that aggressively defends the crumbling compound against outsiders and rival tribes.

faq.q: Where are the Tkashi Ruins located?
faq.answer: They lie in northern Stranglethorn Vale, just southwest of the river crossing near Nesingwary's Expedition.

faq.q: What is mentioned about Tkashi in Hemet Nesingwary's writings?
faq.answer: In chapter three of his memoir, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn (specifically page 21), Nesingwary records that he and his hunting party managed to traverse the Tkashi Ruins without incident during their early days in the jungle.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, sites like Tkashi are grim reminders of the ancient tribal ruins left behind by their hostile Gurubashi kin, now fiercely defended by savage Bloodscalp holdouts.
